title: ProviderConfig
description: Configuration for one LLM, search, or embedding provider instance. Provider names, adapters, and models are configuration values, never domain enums (docs/api/PROVIDERS.md).

base_url.description: Endpoint root, e.g. https://api.example.com/v1 or http://127.0.0.1:11434.

key_reference.description: OS keychain reference; the key VALUE never appears in any persisted record, log, event, or prompt. Local providers may omit it.

model.description: Model identifier, e.g. 'glm-4.7' or 'qwen3:8b'. Configuration, not a domain enum.

extra_headers.description: Additional headers; values must be non-secret. Redacted in logs.
